articles.summary: Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: PPIH), a global leader in engineered piping and corrosion protection solutions, today announced that its North American operations secured new orders in excess of $28 million during the first two months of the Company’s fiscal third quarter. The new orders secured to date in the fiscal third quarter of 2026 span district heating, Canadian oil and gas, and U.S. data center projects, reflecting continued commercial momentum and strengthening demand across the region. The Company expects Canadian oil and gas customers to be more active this winter season, due to seasonal operating requirements and ongoing energy infrastructure activities that are expected to provide additional business opportunities. articles.title: Perma-Pipe Announces New Orders Exceeding $28 Million in North America Through First Two Months of Fiscal Q3, with Strong Winter Activity Expected in Canadian Oil and Gas Sector
